subject: Duplicate API calls from webhook retries — request to pause collection and audit
messages:
From: Marta Kovac <accounts@luminahealth.eu>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ivan Petrov <ivan.petrov@luminahealth.eu>
Date: Mon, 30 Apr 2028 08:12:00 +0000
Subject: Unexpected spike — duplicate calls from our webhook retries (urgent)

Hi Rishi,

We're seeing a large jump on our April 29 invoice — approximately 1.8M tokens more than expected. Our engineering team traced the bulk of the traffic to a surge of webhook retries from a new async queue we rolled out last week. The retries are being sent under two different API keys (we rotated keys during the rollout) so the requests show up as separate clients in your usage export.

Can you: 1) pause payment collection for the invoice under review while we audit, 2) provide a filtered export for activity originating from the two service keys between 2028-04-28T22:00Z and 2028-04-29T06:00Z, and 3) confirm whether those duplicated calls are eligible for a provisional credit under Redwood policy?

I've attached a small sample of request IDs and a CSV snapshot from our side.

We also need clarity on VAT treatment — Lumina Health is an EU-registered entity and intends to apply reverse-charge for professional services; if you issue a provisional credit, will that affect the VAT position for the invoice?

Thanks,
Marta Kovac
Head of Finance, Lumina Health
attachments: lumina_billing_snapshot_20280429.csv, request-ids-sample.txt

--
On Mon, Apr 30, 2028 at 10:40 AM Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai> wrote:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Kovac <accounts@luminahealth.eu>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Apr 2028 10:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Unexpected spike — duplicate calls from our webhook retries (urgent)

Thanks for the heads up and the sample, Marta — sorry for the disruption.

Quick note on next steps from our side:
- Kimberly (billing) will unblock a provisional hold request for collections while we pull the filtered export and run a duplication analysis.
- Ben (technical account lead) will coordinate with our infra team to trace the request IDs and confirm attribution across API keys.
- I will confirm the provisional-credit policy and VAT implications with Finance & Legal; provisional credits don't automatically change VAT treatment but we can provide a corrective invoice once the audit is complete.

Kimberly / Ben — can you confirm ETA for the filtered export and whether we can apply a short-term collection hold on invoice INV-2028-04-LH-082?

Rishi

--
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marta Kovac <accounts@luminahealth.eu>
Date: Mon, 30 Apr 2028 13:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Unexpected spike — duplicate calls from our webhook retries (urgent)

Looping in billing analysis — Marta, we can place a provisional hold on collection for one invoice cycle (up to 30 days) while the forensic run completes. To do that we need:
- signed request from Lumina's finance team (email OK) confirming audit in progress,
- sample request IDs you provided (we have them), and
- confirmation you agree to reconcile any legitimate usage once the audit finishes.

Ben, can you confirm whether your team can produce a bucketed CSV showing: timestamp, request_id, api_key, model, token_count, and request_hash for 2028-04-28T20:00Z through 2028-04-29T12:00Z? If the same request_id appears twice under different api_key values we treat that as duplicated attempts subject to adjustment.

If duplication > 25% of the spike we'll offer a provisional credit equal to the duplicated token portion pending final reconciliation; less than that we'll do a case-by-case manual adjustment. Also: since Lumina is EU-registered and uses reverse-charge, any credit we issue will be accompanied by a corrective invoice that reverses the billed VAT; we will coordinate the timing with Lumina's finance lead.

Kimberly Park
Senior Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

--
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marta Kovac <accounts@luminahealth.eu>
Date: Tue, 01 May 2028 09:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Unexpected spike — duplicate calls from our webhook retries (urgent)

Hi all,

I pulled the sample and kicked off the forensic job — ETA for the full filtered CSV is ~36 hours (should have it by Tue 2028-05-02 21:00 UTC). Early look at the request_ids sample: about 62% of the top 500 requests show identical payload hashes but appear under two api_key values with timestamps separated by 1–3 seconds (classic retry storm). We'll include a dedup marker in the export.

Notes on approach:
- We'll flag a request as duplicate when request_hash and request_body match and request_id is identical or shows a retry counter header;
- For tokens attributed to duplicates we'll compute the sum and return a provisional credit estimate in the export;
- We will also provide a list of affected API keys so Lumina can confirm rotation timeline.

I recommend we provisionally credit the duplicated portion while keeping the invoice on hold per Kimberly's guidance. Marta — can you confirm the signed hold request by reply? Also, please confirm whether Lumina expects a single corrective invoice or split adjustments per EU entity (I see Lumina Health has two VAT-registered subsidiaries).

Ben Carter
Technical Account Lead, Redwood Inference
attachments: forensic_job_ticket_99023.txt

--
From: Marta Kovac <accounts@luminahealth.eu>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 02 May 2028 15:04:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Unexpected spike — duplicate calls from our webhook retries (urgent)

Thanks — confirmed. Lumina agrees to a provisional hold and requests a single corrective invoice routed to Lumina Health B.V. (VAT NL123456789). We will reconcile and pay any legitimate usage after the audit. 

Signed: Marta Kovac
Head of Finance, Lumina Health

attachments: lumina_signed_hold_request.pdf
